title: The Missing Rose Oil
scene: At 3:40 PM, the rare rose oil vial vanished from the mixing bench. Only the perfumer saw the cracked amber dropper left beside it.

suspects.name: Astrid Sorensen
suspects.testimony: I reviewed invoices in the alcove from 3:20 to 3:45 PM—I never touched any cracked amber dropper!
suspects.contradiction: Nobody had mentioned a cracked amber dropper, and rose oil scented Astrid's coat cuff.

suspects.name: Camille Duval
suspects.testimony: I greeted clients in the front parlor from 3:20 to 3:40 PM before returning to the mixing bench.
suspects.alibiProof: Two brides sampled scents with Camille in the front parlor from 3:20 to 3:40 PM.

suspects.name: Anton Kovic
suspects.testimony: I unpacked empty vials right beside the mixing bench from 3:25 to 3:45 PM.
suspects.alibiProof: The shop assistant helped Anton count unpacked vials beside the bench from 3:25 to 3:45 PM.

suspects.name: Bruno Ricci
suspects.testimony: I pressed dried petals in the courtyard from 3:20 to 3:45 PM and never stepped inside.
suspects.alibiProof: The florist next door chatted with Bruno across the courtyard fence from 3:20 to 3:45 PM.
